name: RecipientList
summary: Sends a message to a set of destinations the sender computes, so that who receives it is decided per message rather than by a subscription.

roles.name: RecipientList
roles.summary: The participant that computes the recipients of one message and sends a copy to each. Unlike a publish-subscribe channel, the decision is the sender's and per message, which is what lets it depend on the message's content.

roles.name: Recipients
roles.summary: The destinations computed for this message. Exposing them is what makes the routing decision auditable rather than a side effect nobody can inspect after the fact.
